meta.name: baoyu-post-to-wechat
meta.description: Posts content to WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) via API or Chrome CDP. Supports article posting (文章) with HTML, markdown, or plain text input, and image-text posting (图文) with multiple images. Use when user mentions "发布公众号", "post to wechat", "微信公众号", or "图文/文章".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容自动发布到微信公众号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把文章或图文发布到微信公众号
copy.tagline_en: Automatically post content to WeChat Official Account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to post articles or image-text to WeChat Official Account

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你把文章或图文内容发布到微信公众号。它支持 HTML、Markdown 或纯文本输入，能自动转换格式、生成标题摘要，并通过 API 或浏览器两种方式提交草稿。
howto.when: 当你提到“发布公众号”、“post to wechat”、“微信公众号”、“图文”或“文章”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这篇 Markdown 文章发布到公众号。
发布一张图片和一段文字到公众号。
say.note: Claude 会使用浏览器方式发布图文消息。

say.text: 用 API 发布这个 HTML 文件到公众号。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供 API 凭证，然后直接提交草稿。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you post articles or image-text content to a WeChat Official Account. It supports HTML, Markdown, or plain text input, automatically converts formats, generates titles and summaries, and submits drafts via API or browser.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "发布公众号", "post to wechat", "微信公众号", "图文", or "文章".

say_en.text: Publish this Markdown article to my WeChat Official Account.
Post an image with text to WeChat Official Account.
say_en.note: Claude will use the browser method to publish an image-text post.

say_en.text: Use API to publish this HTML file to WeChat Official Account.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for API credentials and submit the draft directly.
